title: perf(usage): bound session reports and retain visible results

commit.messageHeadline: perf(usage): bound session reports and retain visible results
perf(usage): batch durable snapshots and physical target resolution
test(usage): migrate overview fixture to row contract
test(usage): finish overview row contract migration
fix(usage): keep partition snapshots independent of the cache kernel
test(usage): normalize absent owner summaries to null
fix(usage): bound cached payloads and backfill visible pages
fix(usage): preserve bounded reads with idle refresh batching
perf(usage): reuse the final synchronous visibility frame
test(usage): isolate refresh clocks and compare paths
perf(usage): avoid repeated source encoding and capability reads
fix(usage): preserve deferred freshness and repair corrupt cache bodies
test(usage): cover corrupt bodies after partition deferral
fix(usage): preserve bounded decoding across cache snapshots
test(usage): retain stored body facts in admission proof
fix(usage): isolate request cancellation and repair partition metadata
fix(usage): reject impossible partition sizes before deferral
test(usage): narrow generated partition fixtures
fix(usage): preserve exact reads across bounded reports
fix(usage): bound actor snapshots before cloning reports

Addressed all five inline findings in fd77a0a51040789be7af711302d296b71a8237e3. The creator filter now precedes the instance ceiling; resident capabilities replace serial authority acquisition across context-bearing populations; page hydration backfills once after revocation; and cache payloads are streamed under a shared encoded/decoded allowance. Budget-deferred current rows stay partial without refresh, while stale or unverifiable checkpoints preserve their refresh targets.

The three new handler regressions fail on the prior handler and pass with the fixes. Full affected handler/lifecycle files pass 23/23; physical-owner attribution passes 11/11; worker I/O, SQLite cache, and projection files pass 37/37. Changed-file formatting/lint and independent re-review are clean. New exact-head PR CI and final fixture measurements are in progress.

The two remaining cache-budget findings are addressed in 1855dacceea0, with the partition-deferral regression in e496479f0145. Producer length invariants are validated before budget deferral. A compact numeric checkpoint reservation within the existing 32 MiB allowance preserves freshness when full headers cannot fit; stale checkpoints still request repair.

The SQL reader also carries actual stored body length from its existing batched query. Missing or truncated data cannot become current-deferred, and the refresh producer forces a canonical rebuild even without a retained full-header rebuild snapshot. The focused SQLite/projection files pass 33/33, including actual worker repair on an unchanged transcript and invalid-body handling after partition deferral. The codec's Unicode/compression and corrupt-length cases pass, and final independent re-review is clean. Exact-head PR CI is running; these are repairs rather than CI reruns.

Addressed the remaining review findings through their owning boundaries:

- Unaligned exact ranges do not load unused monthly partitions. The SQLite regression returns exact replay totals even when those partitions are oversized/corrupt; aligned requests still reject and repair the same corruption.
- Missing or oversized partition metadata now marks the path invalid, overriding budget deferral regardless of row order. Both oversized-first and oversized-last cases fail against the preceding implementation and pass after repair. Canonical refresh restores within-month, cross-month and full-range totals.
- Each `sessions.usage` cold load owns its request cancellation; completed snapshots still use the existing cache. The real-handler regression starts identical requests, disconnects one, and verifies that the other remains active and returns its totals. It fails against the prior shared-flight implementation.

Independent subagent review (autoreview route unavailable) is clean for the production changes and the CI test-type corrections. No operator configuration, schema, index or public request shape changed. Focused handler/cache/SQLite proof passes 61 tests; additional final worker/SQLite proof and exact-head PR CI are recorded in the PR body.

Fixed the partition-size finding before landing. The decoder now validates the producer's cheap encoding/length invariants before applying the decoded-byte allowance: identity bytes must equal the stored blob length; zstd bytes must exceed it because the producer compresses only when smaller.

The new SQLite regression reproduces the prior bug with a small blob whose header claims 35 MiB of identity data: the preceding decoder returns a pending row with no stale or invalid receipt. The repaired decoder reports invalid data, and canonical refresh restores the full and filtered totals. Seven codec cases and four SQLite repair variants pass (11/11 selected), including zero-budget invalid-versus-deferred cases. Fresh independent subagent review (autoreview route unavailable) is clean. Final-head CI and the complete-source measurement are recorded in the PR body.

The private memory-store budget finding is fixed in `1122dba5f2e047f05bb66c4d553841c79e227a50`. The existing actor snapshot owner now admits bounded cache inputs before copying them; retained headers/bodies and decoding share 32 MiB, with 1 MiB body and 64 KiB header limits. Compact numeric checkpoint facts preserve current deferrals without refresh; missing/truncated bodies and oversized headers remain canonical repair work, including when the report cannot retain a header receipt.

All 16 focused memory tests pass, with formatting, focused lint and diff checks clean. Three regressions fail against the old snapshot/decoder: oversized valid bodies and compressed expansion are incorrectly decoded, and 40 individually small bodies retain 36,941,280 bytes against the 33,554,432-byte cap. Fresh independent review is clean. This adds no stored shape, schema, configuration or public RPC option.

The durable fixture measurement is source-pinned to the preceding integrated head: median wall 2,057.6→863.2 ms and worker CPU 1,940→670 ms. This actor-only correction is not exercised by that fixture and has no incognito performance claim. Aggregate main CPU rises 620→760 ms across the three measured requests; that tradeoff is retained in the body. Final exact-head PR CI remains the broad gate; no CI rerun has been requested.
